Healing after surgery requires the right support. Fortunately, the Baddie Booty compression bra provides everything you need for a smooth recovery. This vest combines medical-grade compression with a stylish design.

  • Invisible Look: Wear it under your clothes for a seamless, “snatched” appearance.

In conclusion, the Baddie Booty vest is an essential tool for your health. Whether you are at home or back at work, this bra supports your body every step of the way.

Elevate your recovery and define your curves with the Hourglass Sculpt Faja. Engineered specifically for the “Cinch & Flare” look, this Stage 2 compression garment is designed for those who demand a microscopic waist without sacrificing hip volume.
